title: JD(U) legislators project Nishant Kumar as future Bihar CM
description: JD(U) national president Nitish Kumar, MLAs, MLCs, and other senior leaders of the party, including national working president Sanjay Kumar Jha, attended the legislative party meeting; Mr. Nishant did not react to his projection of leading the party but rather chose to use the platform to attack the Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD)
